A concluding note says the types are neither exhaustive nor mutually exclusive: sources can be georeferenced, and some administrative and geospatial data can be machine-generated. Interoperability can use common numeric identifiers, geospatial coordinates, time stamps, and classification standards. Three footnotes discuss social-media surveys, cite Meijer and Potjer (2018), and refer readers to chapter 4.","limitations":"The box is text-led and has no quantitative values.
